name: Leading Lines + Landmark
principle: Use natural lines (paths, lighting strips, broken architecture) to guide the player's eye to a memorable landmark that anchors the level.
when_to_use: Any new biome introduction or critical decision point.
rules_of_thumb: One landmark per screen at gameplay distance.
Landmark silhouette must read in a single glance under one second.
Leading lines should converge on the landmark from at least two directions.
Negative space around the landmark = at least 25 % of its bounding box.
anti_patterns: Leading lines that point off-screen with no payoff.
